title: Sociodemographic Prompting is Not Yet an Effective Approach for Simulating Subjective Judgments with LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating how Large Language Models (LLMs) align with demographic groups (gender and ethnicity) on subjective tasks like politeness and offensiveness. While it discusses social norms and includes an ethics section regarding the study's impact, it does not explicitly benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, or formal ethical/moral systems.
